data.one_liner: Geographical Map widget for Flutter supporting different projections and tile providers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a lightweight and powerful geographical map widget written entirely in Dart with no native platform code. It supports various tile providers like Google Maps, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap, along with caching and multiple projections.
use_when: You need a vendor-free map widget that works with custom tiles or multiple providers
You want a pure Dart map implementation without native platform dependencies across all platforms
avoid_when: You require fully managed native vector maps out of the box without configuring tile sources
You need built-in advanced geolocation tracking services
strengths: Written entirely in Dart with no native platform code
Supports Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Vector tile support is still under development in separate packages
Requires manual setup for tile sources and interaction logic
data.setup_notes: No native platform configuration is required since it is written entirely in Dart.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: A popular alternative map package for Flutter built around OpenStreetMap tiles.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically want official native Google Maps integration.
